development_rule: repetition == 1 for every (system, root_cause_service, fault) stratum, 25 strata per system
preprocessing: official RCAEval main.py: drop time.1 if present, drop *_latency-50, replace +-inf with NaN, ffill, fillna(0), take tail(600) rows before inject_time and head(600) rows at/after, then rename *_latency-90 to *_latency
interface: rank(data, inject_time, metadata) -> list[str], a permutation of every metric column (time excluded), most suspicious root cause first
objective: official service-level Avg@5 over all development cases, computed with the pinned RCAEval Evaluator; any failure fails the candidate
data_access: offline unsupervised per-case metric windows; no labels, case names, root-cause service or fault type are exposed to the candidate; system identity and the fixed system SLI column are metadata
execution_profile: Linux CUDA; candidate network access denied
